boxes.text:
You can move and resize jit.ui objects with your mouse by interacting with them in the rendering window.

First unlock the patch, then edit the the objects by using the handles provided.

- Press "Shift" + drag on a corner for scaling. 
- Press "Cmd" + drag on center handle for snap to grid (grid must be on)
jit.ui objects always need a jit.ui.canvas to draw to.
pak padding i i i i
A jit.ui.group can contain other groups.
These attributes are only relevant for the jit.ui objects when they are attached to a jit.ui.group.

You can use an image to texture 
the background of jit.ui objects.
You can also use a procedurally generated texture.
Allow object to be modified with mouse interaction
Set position, width and height in pixel
pak padding i i i i
If there is more than one toggle in the group, radiogroup_mode 1 will make the toggles mutually exclusive
You can remove all the ui objects from the group by changing the group's name
